controls.nativeLaunch: A complete v2 request is parsed against the Pay allowlist and written to protected storage before launchNativeAuthorization resolves the exact request-bearing URI. Linking.openURL runs only after the accepted native resolver reports a handler.
controls.pendingAndCallback: The protected pending request is restored after cold launch and parseAuthorizationCallbackURL binds approve/reject to that exact request before it is removed.
controls.fallback: An unsupported native resolver leaves Pay on its existing page and exposes only the accepted official YNX Wallet download and MetaMask fallback actions.
controls.metaMask: connectMetaMaskWallet uses EIP-6963 discovery or an EIP-1193 MetaMask provider only and has no YNX Wallet URL path.
controls.privateService: No Product Session or payment authority is created by the launcher. Optional private-service unavailability is classified as PRIVATE_SERVICE_DEGRADED without deleting Standard Wallet connectivity.
controls.webExtension: Not applicable to this checkpoint's native Pay authorization surface. No top-level Web/Extension custom-scheme navigation was added or claimed.

visibleEvidence.reason: adb reported no connected device. No Pay APK installation, Wallet authorization result, payment, or browser visible result is claimed.

remainingBlocker: A bootable device with compatible YNX Wallet is required for the complete request screen, approve/reject callback, cold-start recovery, second launch and network-loss Retry evidence. The accepted endpoint manifest remains PENDING.
